- OPENING CONTINUITY is authoritative.
- Do not perform NEXT BEAT.
- CONTAINMENT HANDOFF: If CURRENT BEAT places a subject inside a room/container and then locks, seals, or closes the barrier around that subject, preserve that subject as remaining inside/behind that barrier in all later micro-beats and in END CONTINUITY unless CURRENT BEAT explicitly releases or moves them again. Do not re-co-locate a contained subject beside another character merely because they were together earlier.
- If OPENING CONTINUITY already places a subject behind a locked/sealed barrier, that subject must not appear beside an outside character, receive unrelated props, or participate in later staging unless CURRENT BEAT explicitly opens/releases the barrier and moves that subject.
- Do not invent consequential persistent changes not authorized by CURRENT BEAT.
- END CONTINUITY must be nearly identical to the final micro-beat and limited to one sentence.

OPENING CONTINUITY
Will and Amber remain inside the locked basement. Amy is in the kitchen holding a pistol and katana.

CURRENT BEAT
Amy shoots the first zombie in the kitchen and watches it collapse dead.
